name: Sri Krishna Stores
about: Neighbourhood grocery store with 3 branches in Bengaluru

tour.title: Start with the briefing
tour.text: The dark panel sums up the whole store: the key numbers for the last full month and how many things need attention.

tour.title: One branch is slipping
tour.text: Jayanagar's cancellations jumped from April 2026. Alerts puts it first, with what to check.

tour.title: A courier with many returns
tour.text: Orders sent through QuickDrop courier come back about 5x as often. Open the finding to see the rows behind it.

tour.title: Best sellers on empty shelves
tour.text: Three of the store's best sellers are out of stock, and two imported items have not sold at all.

tour.title: Try a change
tour.text: Move the discount slider to see what the COMBO5 offer costs in profit.

name: Tara Boutique
about: Women's clothing sold in store, online and on Instagram

tour.title: Start with the briefing
tour.text: The dark panel sums up the boutique: revenue, profit and what needs attention.

tour.title: Website orders come back
tour.text: Orders from the website are returned about 4x as often as store or Instagram orders. Sizing is the usual reason.

tour.title: A coupon that costs too much
tour.text: FEST30 brings in orders, but its profit margin is about 17 points lower.

tour.title: Instagram is growing
tour.text: Instagram's share keeps rising month after month, and October and November peak every year.

tour.title: Regulars who stopped coming
tour.text: A group of regular customers has gone quiet. They are worth a call or a message.

name: Bean There Café
about: Two-outlet café with dine-in, takeaway and delivery apps

tour.title: Start with the briefing
tour.text: The dark panel sums up both outlets: sales, profit and what needs attention.

tour.title: One counter, many refunds
tour.text: Counter 3 refunds about 8x as often as the others. Worth checking training or the till.

tour.title: Delivery apps earn less per order
tour.text: Delivery-app orders are about 15% smaller after the app discount.

tour.title: Weekends carry the café
tour.text: Saturday and Sunday are far busier than weekdays. Plan staff and stock around them.

tour.title: See how Alpha did it
tour.text: Every step from reading the files to the checks is listed here, in order.
